notes: US teams publish no accounts: revenue, operating income (EBITDA net of stadium debt service), player expenses and value are Forbes estimates for the 2025 season from the list of 9 Sep 2026, cited via Wayback copies because forbes.com refuses scripted fetches. Forbes puts debt at 2% of value (Debt/Value 2%) but states no amount, so net_debt is blank. Capacity 100,000 is Forbes' figure (expandable configuration; the fixed seating is lower) and the Hall of Fame calls it a '100,000-plus seat stadium'. Jones' 1989 purchase price is not stated on a page read. No ownership transaction, minority stake or private-equity investment since 2015 was found; the Jones children's stakes are not stated. Legal entity, attendance and social follower counts not found on a citable page. NFL kits are league-wide Nike; no shirt sponsor in the NFL.
